
RETAG
Replace one tag with another across all feature files

USAGE
  fspec retag <old-tag> <new-tag> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <old-tag> (required)
    Tag to replace
  <new-tag> (required)
    New tag name

OPTIONS
  --dry-run
    Preview changes without making modifications

EXAMPLES
  1. Replace @wip with @in-progress in all features
  $ fspec retag @wip @in-progress
  ✓ Replaced @wip with @in-progress in 5 feature files
✓ Updated 12 scenarios

  2. Preview tag replacement
  $ fspec retag @old @new --dry-run
  [DRY RUN] Would replace @old with @new in:
  - spec/features/login.feature (2 occurrences)
  - spec/features/checkout.feature (1 occurrence)

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec register-tag
  fspec update-tag
  fspec validate-tags

NOTES
  • Both tags must be registered in spec/tags.json
  • Updates both feature-level and scenario-level tags
  • Run validate-tags after retagging to verify changes
  • Use --dry-run to preview before making changes
